summary: NORDPEP iteration 5 — free-shipping threshold + auto-cancel unpaid orders — fully verified. Backend: 3/3 new pytest cases PASS (test_iter5_shipping_autocancel.py) + 40/41 regression across all suites (1 pre-existing flaky email-log test unrelated to this iteration). Frontend: /checkout summary correctly shows $20.00 shipping + free-shipping-hint under $200, FREE (EN) / GRATUIT (FR) at >=$200; /compliance has shipping-section-carriers + shipping-section-unpaid-orders with correct copy; /faq has faq-item-free-shipping + faq-item-unpaid, accordions open on trigger click with expected content ($20, 48h, cancel).

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — Emergent visual-editor instrumentation wraps option text in <span>. Runtime works but console spam. Not blocking; may want to disable ve-instrumentation for <option> children.

critical_code_review_comments: _build_order_totals (server.py:520) correctly applies FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD_CAD after discount is subtracted: `shipping = 0.0 if (subtotal - discount) >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD_CAD else SHIPPING_FLAT_CAD` — matches frontend Checkout.jsx:51 computation, preventing UI/API drift.
cancel_stale_unpaid_orders uses an atomic conditional update (matches on original payment_status) before restocking, so concurrent watchdog runs / manual admin actions cannot double-restock. Good.
_restock_order_items correctly skips preorder line items and handles both variant and legacy (_default) SKUs. Verified via test — variant stock returned to original after cancellation.
Watchdog cadence is 1h (`await asyncio.sleep(3600)`) — reasonable. Also runs immediately at startup so a restart flushes any accumulated stale orders — verified.

System note structure is `{id, text, author='system', created_at}` — note that iter3 admin notes use key `admin_email`/`ts` while watchdog uses `author`/`created_at`. Minor inconsistency in notes schema across the two writers; consider unifying to a single {id, text, author, created_at} shape for easier UI rendering.
FAQ accordion + Compliance sections have correct data-testids and copy present in both FR/EN arrays.
test_credentials: Admin admin@nordpep.ca / NordpepAdmin2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Guest checkout used for iter5 tests — no auth required.
seed_data_creation: Test creates transient orders (deleted at test end) and briefly decrements/re-increments variant stock. All test data cleaned up in fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is now 4 files: test_nordpep_api.py, test_iter3_features.py, test_iter5_shipping_autocancel.py (+ conftest? none). Run with: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v -o addopts=. iter5 test restarts backend via `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` and waits up to 45s for the startup-watchdog to cancel a backdated order — expect test wall time ~15-20s. Pre-existing flake test_iter2_checkout_logs_two_emails is log-window dependent and fails intermittently when the log ring buffer is full — not related to shipping/auto-cancel.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration 5 implementation. Main agent's manual curl verification matches automated results: qty=1 (subtotal $64.99) → shipping $20; qty=4 (subtotal $259.96) → shipping $0; backdate created_at 72h + backend restart → payment_status='cancelled', fulfillment_status='cancelled', system note added with exact text 'Auto-cancelled: payment not received within 48h', variant stock incremented back by ordered qty.
